results.title: Fire breaks out at Maharashtra Minister Ganesh Naik’s official bungalow in Mumbai; no injuries reported
results.content: Minister was not present in the house during the incident; BMC says the fire was reported in an air-conditioning unit at the bungalow

results.title: Haryana Congress to launch campaign to protect people’s voting rights, says Sanjay Dutt
results.content: All India Congress Committee Haryana in-charge Sanjay Dutt and Haryana Pradesh Congress Committee president Rao Narender Singh will lead the two-week tour, participating in ‘Chaupals’ (community gatherings)

results.title: AAP meets CAQM, complains about alleged AQI manipulation
results.content: AAP Delhi president Saurabh Bharadwaj claimed that the CAQM had acknowledged that spraying water on monitoring stations was wrong and assured action against the responsible Delhi government officials; but the CAQM statement was silent on any promises made to the AAP

results.title: Fox on runway and hijack alert, passengers had a harrowing time at Kolkata Airport
results.content: A Chennai to Kolkata flight was diverted to Andal in Durgapur after pilot spotted fox on a runway during touch down, while a hijack note was found by the cabin crew inside the lavatory of a Kolkata to Mumbai flight, delaying the departure by several hours

results.title: Ambekar Meetei storms into men’s 50kg final at Youth Olympics
results.content: Ambekar’s semifinal victory against the Colombian ended a 16-year wait for an Indian boxer in a Youth Olympics final, matching the milestone set by Shiva Thapa at the inaugural Singapore 2010 Games

results.title: Anushka Sharma to lead India A in limited-overs series against England
results.content: India A and their English counterparts will first engage in a three-match T20I series to be played at the MCA Stadium in Pune on November 30, and December 3 and 6, before moving to Mumbai for the remainder of the series

results.title: Norwegian journalist Helle Lyng says she has been stopped from coming to Hyderabad for Bharat Summit
results.content: Ms. Lyng says she has been denied entry into India despite having a visa

results.title: Aaryavir in focus as India face Afghanistan in U-19 Asia Cup semifinal
results.content: Aaryavir is the tournament’s leading run-scorer after smashing 160 off 168 balls to guide India to a 70-run win over the UAE in their final Group A match

results.title: Delhi air pollution: Police stop students’ protest march against worsening air quality near Turkman Gate
results.content: Protesters demand stricter enforcement of curbs on industrial emissions, construction dust and vehicular pollution; locality heavily barricaded
